title: Eisenhower aware of foo fighters

tellings.quote: Eisenhower was aware of the Foo Fighters issue from 42 to 45.

plain: A guest named Merrick, debating the skeptic Mick West on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that Dwight Eisenhower, the top Allied general in the Second World War and later president, knew about foo fighters, the odd glowing lights that wartime aircrews reported, from 1942 to 1945. If true, it would mean the highest military leaders knew of unexplained objects as far back as the war.
